summary.text: Xp Lee, also known as Xiongpao, is a Democratic state representative from Minnesota House District 34B who took office in September 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a health equity strategist.

paragraphs.text: Xp Lee earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina Upstate in 2001, and his career experience includes working as a health equity strategist.
Lee assumed office on September 26, 2025, in the seat previously held by Melissa Hortman, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements for his 2026 campaign from AFSCME Council 5, the Minnesota AFL-CIO and Education Minnesota.
He faces Republican Ruth Bittner in the November 3, 2026 general election.
